concerns.location: spec.md:User Story 1 - Data Ingestion and Preprocessing Pipeline
concerns.text: The plan states that the system will download the HCP 1200‑subject release from `https://db.humanconnectome.org` and use it for both resting‑state fMRI and NIH Toolbox Dimensional Change Card Sort scores, yet no verified URLs are provided that actually contain both modalities. Unresolved Phase 0 checks (see unresolved concerns) indicate the listed URLs point to diffusion data and chest‑X‑ray datasets, which lack the required high‑dimensional fMRI time‑series and behavioral scores. Without appropriate data, the core predictor (RSFC variability) and outcome (flexibility score) cannot be computed, rendering the primary research question unanswerable and the entire methodological approach unsound.

The specification uses a 60‑second sliding‑window length (FR‑003) while Constitution Principle VII mandates a default of 30 seconds and requires any deviation to be justified in a technical‑design document. No such justification or reference is provided, violating the constitution and leaving the choice of window length unsubstantiated, which may affect the validity of the variability metric.
